focus_areas: Structural integrity of the mounting arms under the dish
Regularity of the mesh/grid pattern on the dish surface
Geometric correctness of the windows on the support base
Perspective alignment and vanishing point consistency of background objects
Relative scale consistency between foreground and background telescopes
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the mechanical complexity of the mount. AI often simplifies or hallucinates the truss work under large dishes. Verify if the struts connect logically to the pivot point. Also, check the 'brick' texture of the base for repetitive patterns or warping around the windows. Crucially, analyze the perspective lines of the background dishes to ensure they align with a single vanishing point, confirming the physical plausibility of the scene's depth.
image_description: A large radio telescope with a massive parabolic mesh dish antenna mounted on a cylindrical brick support structure. The dish features a visible metal grid surface and complex mechanical underpinnings. In the background, smaller satellite dishes are aligned in a row across a grassy field under an overcast sky.
